properties.name: text
properties.value: The core answers Sera's current pattern. Its transmission is not a distress call: it is a navigational reply aimed at coordinates beyond this planet.

properties.name: emptyText
properties.value: The alien coordinates continue repeating beyond the planetary chart.

properties.name: restoredText
properties.value: The Meridian key is copied. Return to the central control tower near Vesper Crossing.

properties.value: A command locker opens beside the Array core.
